programme.title: True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here
programme.desc: S02 E01 Benton, MO After a teenage girl is found murdered in her car on the side of a highway, a stranger from out of town is convicted of her murder; when the deputy who originally discovered the body becomes sheriff, he calls everything into question.

programme.title: True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here
programme.desc: S02 E02 Wahpeton, ND When the body of a missing student is discovered in the river near a small college town, the community questions the role law enforcement may have played in his death.

programme.title: True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here
programme.desc: S02 E03 New Albany, Mississippi When a beloved member of a tight-knit community is killed, the town cries out for immediate justice; after a young man is sentenced to death for the crime, and an out-of-town lawyer argues they convicted an innocent man.

programme.title: True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here
programme.desc: S02 E04 Prichard, Alabama The murder of a gender-nonconforming Black teenager remains unsolved despite pressure from family and friends - raising issues about the increase of violence, and the lack of justice for trans murder victims across the country.

programme.title: True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here
programme.desc: S02 E05 Aledo, Texas Years after the body of a young woman is found strangled to death in a creek bed, law enforcement finally closes the case; a closer look raises questions about the investigation.

programme.title: True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here
programme.desc: S02 E06 Vinalhaven, Maine On a remote island, a dispute between two lobstermen is settled the way islanders do: face-to-face; the conflict turns deadly when one swings an ax - leaving locals to dispute whether the death was self-defense or murder.

programme.title: The Flight Attendant Murders
programme.desc: S01 E01 The first victim, Jeannie, is introduced through the testimony of her closest friends and family.

programme.title: The Flight Attendant Murders
programme.desc: S01 E02 Experts explore whether there was a missed link made between Jeannie's murder and two more deaths.

programme.title: The Flight Attendant Murders
programme.desc: S01 E03 The cold case investigation into air hostess Jeeta's death provides hope for the past victims.

programme.title: The Flight Attendant Murders
programme.desc: S01 E04 The current investigation attempts to provide definitive answers for the grieving families.

programme.title: Ministry of Evil: The Twisted Cult of Tony Alamo
programme.desc: S01 E01 Episode 1 In the 1960s, preachers Tony and Susan Alamo recruit nomads to join their ministry; former members give insight into the cult's origins.

programme.title: Ministry of Evil: The Twisted Cult of Tony Alamo
programme.desc: S01 E02 Episode 2 Tony and Susan Alamo's grip on power is challenged as Susan becomes ill and law enforcement investigates allegations of labor violations and abuse.

programme.title: Ministry of Evil: The Twisted Cult of Tony Alamo
programme.desc: S01 E03 Episode 3 While on the run, Alamo orders those who remain loyal to him to leave the compound and take his wife's body with them while he tries to evade arrest.

programme.title: Ministry of Evil: The Twisted Cult of Tony Alamo
programme.desc: S01 E04 Episode 4 Out of prison, Tony Alamo begins to make young girls his "wives"; as the child abuse escalates, some ex-members urge the FBI to intervene.

programme.title: The Land
programme.desc: Four inner-city teens face the wrath of a Cleveland crime boss after stealing a car that's stashed with drugs.

programme.title: The Thin Blue Line
programme.desc: Filmmaker Errol Morris studies the 1976 slaying of a Dallas policeman, from different points of view.

programme.title: Into the Ashes
programme.desc: Nick is an ex-con who's adjusting to a new job, a new wife and some semblance of normalcy in rural Alabama. When vengeful former associates track him down, he's soon forced back into the desperate and violent life that he thought he left behind.

programme.title: A Call to Spy
programme.desc: At the dawn of World War II, a desperate Winston Churchill orders his new spy agency to train women for covert operations. Together, these female agents help undermine the Nazi regime in France, leaving an unmistakable legacy in their wake.

programme.title: Exam
programme.desc: Eight candidates cooperate in order to secure a job with a prestigious company.

programme.title: The Vigil
programme.desc: Terror strikes when an Orthodox Jewish man agrees to watch over the dead body of a community member in a dilapidated Brooklyn home.

programme.title: Jonestown: Terror in the Jungle
programme.desc: S01 E01 Making of a Madman Sadistic preacher Jim Jones forms the Peoples Temple after an unusual childhood; the cult's members are captivated; Jones' lust for power becomes unstoppable.

programme.title: Jonestown: Terror in the Jungle
programme.desc: S01 E02 On the Run The press exposes the dark side of Jim Jones, causing a mass exodus to Jonestown; his followers soon realize it's not the utopia their leader promised.

programme.title: Jonestown: Terror in the Jungle
programme.desc: S01 E03 Under Siege A heroic congressman travels to Jonestown; Temple members plot their escape; Jim Jones realizes the walls are closing in and plans his final stand.

programme.title: Jonestown: Terror in the Jungle
programme.desc: S01 E04 Death in the Promised Land The world learns about the mass murder-suicide in Jonestown, orchestrated by cult leader Jim Jones; survivors try to piece their lives back together.

programme.title: The Tailor of Sin City
programme.desc: S01 E01 The Star From the Sticks Small-town tailor AJ Pratt catches the attention of the Kansas City Mob; they move him to Las Vegas, where he's plugged into the star-studded scene designing for celebrities, politicians, and mobsters; he learns a valuable lesson about respect.

programme.title: The Tailor of Sin City
programme.desc: S01 E02 The Cleanest Made Man in Mob History AJ gains a new client: Pablo Escobar, and Escobar introduces AJ to the world of cocaine; when the FBI cracks down on the mob, AJ steps in to help broker a deal, winning favor with the mob while expanding his cocaine smuggling empire.

programme.title: The Tailor of Sin City
programme.desc: S01 E03 Monkey in the Middle AJ struggles to balance his fashion empire, mafia ties and cocaine cartel when the police come knocking.

programme.title: The Tailor of Sin City
programme.desc: S01 E04 Crash Landing (on Purpose) AJ's empire comes crashing down as the FBI closes in, mob violence spirals out of control, and AJ's closest ally is murdered; after barely surviving an attempt on his life, AJ flees the state and claims to turn over a new leaf.

programme.title: Yorkshire Ripper: The Secret Murders
programme.desc: S01 E01 Among the secret murders explored are Judith Roberts, Mary Judge in Leeds in 1968, a schoolgirl killed in Staffordshire in 1972 and Carol Wilkinson, a bakery worker murdered in Bradford in 1977.

programme.title: Yorkshire Ripper: The Secret Murders
programme.desc: S01 E02 The pressure continues to build on West Yorkshire Police; on top of the crimes that police decide to include in the Ripper investigation, murders and attempted murders with a clear link to the killer are discarded and left unsolved.

programme.title: Monkey on a Stick: Murder, Madness, and the Hare Krishnas
programme.desc: S01 E01 The expose of the Hare Krishna movement; investigative journalists uncover a range of criminal activity involving guns, drugs, money laundering, abuse and even murder.

programme.title: Monkey on a Stick: Murder, Madness, and the Hare Krishnas
programme.desc: S01 E02 Part 2 in the chilling exposé of the Hare Krishna movement, investigative journalists uncover a range of criminal activity involving guns, drugs, money laundering, abuse, and even murder; adapted from the New York Times bestselling book.

programme.title: Every Thing Will Be Fine
programme.desc: After he causes a car accident, Tomas (James Franco) spends the next 12 years examining the effects of the tragedy on his life.

programme.title: Dating & New York
programme.desc: After an electric one-night stand, two New York millennials draw up a friends-with-benefits contract to avoid the pitfalls of their past relationships.

programme.title: Anesthesia
programme.desc: The lives of a self-destructive student (Kristen Stewart), a hard-drinking housewife (Gretchen Mol) and an impoverished junkie (K. Todd Freeman) are linked to the brutal attack of a Columbia University philosophy professor (Sam Waterston).

programme.title: Pelé
programme.desc: Under guidance from manager Vicente Feola (Vincent D'Onofrio), young Pelé (Kevin de Paula) utilizes his street soccer skills to lead Brazil to the World Cup in 1958.

programme.title: Frances Ha
programme.desc: Frances (Greta Gerwig) goes from apartment to apartment in Brooklyn as she looks for a job and a stable partner.

programme.title: Taurus
programme.desc: A rising but troubled musician searches for the inspiration to record his next song, pushing himself deep into the void.

programme.title: Would You Rather
programme.desc: Iris (Brittany Snow) and seven other desperate people become trapped in Shepard's (Jeffrey Combs) mansion. Shepard forces them to play a sadistic game for a large sum of money -- but the dilemmas become increasingly deadly.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Indefensible
programme.desc: S01 E01 How Men Get Off An Arizona man claims jewelry thieves killed his wife, but his story unravels almost immediately; his temporary insanity defense, however, proves to be a formidable opponent in court.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Indefensible
programme.desc: S01 E02 The Consent Offense Police believe they've solved a mysterious death in Florida, but at trial the case takes a shocking turn, and a seemingly straight-forward case of murder by strangulation spirals into a bizarre crime story.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Indefensible
programme.desc: S01 E03 A Few Bad Men A man with a violent criminal history is imprisoned after he nearly kills his girlfriend; just months after he's released early on parole, he finds himself at the center of another tragic case.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Indefensible
programme.desc: S01 E04 The Panic Defense Two strangers meet at a bar, but their evening ends with a gruesome death; police think they know who's to blame, but questions of motive leave them stumped.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Indefensible
programme.desc: S01 E05 The Perfect Victim One woman escapes the clutches of a New Jersey serial killer; the friends and family of another victim set a trap to deliver the killer to police.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Indefensible
programme.desc: S01 E06 Helen & Olga Two elderly women in Los Angeles seem to pull off the perfect murder; when they try to pull it off again nearly six years later, things don't go as planned.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Indefensible
programme.desc: S01 E07 Junk Science In Palm Bay, Fla., a seemingly innocent man is found guilty of murder and sentenced to life in prison; the strongest evidence against him is a debunked form of forensic science.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Indefensible
programme.desc: S01 E08 The Casey Anthony Episode One of the most famous cases in modern history ends with a verdict that shakes the nation; questions arise over who is responsible, and what part trial consultants and the media play in the outcome.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Indefensible
programme.desc: S01 E09 Stand Her Ground Facing 20 years in prison for firing a warning shot, a Florida woman is denied use of a controversial legal defense; learning what went wrong, and who "stand your ground" laws are really designed for.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Indefensible
programme.desc: S01 E10 Elephant in the Womb A Wisconsin woman goes to a hospital hoping to confirm her pregnancy and get medical help, but she instead steps into a nightmare; after being held captive for several days and denied a lawyer, she is thrown in jail.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Indefensible
programme.desc: S01 E11 Concrete Ceiling A California woman who claims she was acting in self-defense ends up in prison for murder; while there, she finds her story is much more common than she realizes.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Indefensible
programme.desc: S01 E12 Bye Bye Wozniak A senseless double murder lands a California man on death row; despite the harsh sentence, a broken system surrounding the death penalty leaves everyone feeling that justice hasn't been served.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Look Into My Eyes
programme.desc: S01 E01 Absorb Attention At North Port High School in Florida, three students die within months of each other; as the community learns more, they discover a common thread: all three students were hypnotized by their principal, Dr. George Kenney, not long before they died.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Look Into My Eyes
programme.desc: S01 E02 Bypass the Critical Dr. George Kenney begins to reveal his side of the story; as details emerge about the deaths and Marcus, Wesley and Brittany's parents speak out, an investigation into Kenney's hypnosis practice begins; the North Port community grows suspicious.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Look Into My Eyes
programme.desc: S01 E03 Activate the Unconscious The press catches wind of the story, and it captures headlines worldwide; Dr. Kenney is asked to leave North Port High, and as the criminal trial heats up, the community is split on his culpability; a student comes forward with a new perspective.

programme.title: Blind Horizon
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her. (Drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 2004

programme.title: Hit & Run
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down. (Comedy, Action, Adventure) - 2012

programme.title: Gerry
programme.desc: Friends Gerry (Casey Affleck) and Gerry (Matt Damon) hike into Death Valley, but they stray so far from the trail that they have no idea how to get back. Initially, they maintain morale by rehashing old stories and reciting inside jokes, but the gravity of their situation sinks in as a return to civilization becomes more unlikely. As the sheer scope, hypnotic pull and spirit-crushing mirages of the desert affect the men, their will to live and sense of identity is challenged and transformed. (Drama) - 2002

programme.title: Jack's Back
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 1988

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob. (Crime drama) - 2009

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A military experiment to harness unlimited energy goes horribly awry, leaving a pilot with no choice but to fight through an imploding world to save his family and the planet itself. (Family, Science fiction, Action, Thriller, Drama) - 2017

programme.title: 10th and Wolf
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them. (Drama) - 2006

programme.desc: A tough cop (Jason Statham) goes after a serial killer who targets police officers. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action) - 2011

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A boy (Julian Dennison) and his foster father (Sam Neill) become the subjects of a manhunt after they get stranded in the New Zealand wilderness. (Comedy, Adventure) - 2016

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: After his eccentric pal (Zach Galifianakis) inherits a fortune from his estranged father, an aimless, womanizing weatherman (Owen Wilson) becomes involved in the legal battle initiated by his friend's sister (Amy Poehler). (Comedy drama) - 2013

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Emily, who is pregnant, quickly becomes friends with her new, pregnant neighbor. Little does Emily know that Kelly has been faking her pregnancy so she can steal her baby. (Thriller) - 2017

programme.title: The Getaway
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive. (Action, Adventure, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1994

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love. (Comedy drama) - 2014

programme.title: Going All the Way
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war. (Drama) - 1997

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways. (Action, Thriller) - 2019

programme.title: The Heart of Me
programme.desc: A woman (Helena Bonham Carter) has an affair with her older sister's (Olivia Williams) husband (Paul Bettany) and bears his child. (Drama) - 2002

programme.title: Homeboy
programme.desc: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby. (Drama) - 1988

programme.title: Before I Go to Sleep
programme.desc: Ever since a vicious attack nearly claimed her life, Christine Lucas (Nicole Kidman) has suffered from anterograde amnesia and is unable to form new memories. Every morning, she becomes reacquainted with her husband, Ben (Colin Firth), and the other constants in her life. In accordance with her doctor's (Mark Strong) instructions, Christine keeps a video diary. As Christine starts to uncover terrifying truths about her past, she begins to question everything -- and everyone -- around her. (Thriller, Drama) - 2014

That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag. (Action, Thriller) - 2006

With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road. programme.sub-title: After arriving in the lively city of Whitesails with Bee and Tonio, a wide-eyed Will looks to recover from his long, tiring journey.

programme.title: D.Gray-man
programme.desc: Allen Walker joins the Black Order and trains intensively in order to become an exorcist and take down Millennium Earl. He must race against time before the villain uses his lethal weapon, the Akuma.
